title: Advanced Ski Downhill with Scoring System
prompt:
Create an advanced ski downhill game using Three.js with the following detailed specifications:

## Scene Setup
- Use a perspective camera (FOV 60, near 0.1, far 2000) positioned behind and above the skier.
- Add a directional light (white, intensity 1.2) at position (50, 100, 50) and an ambient light (0x8888ff, intensity 0.4) for snowy atmosphere.
- Create a long downhill slope using a PlaneGeometry(30, 500) rotated to face the camera, textured white (0xf0f0ff) to simulate snow. The slope should be tilted ~15 degrees downhill along the Z axis.
- Add fog (0xc0c8e0, near 50, far 300) for depth effect.
- The skybox/background color should be 0x87CEEB (sky blue).

## Skier (Player)
- Load the 3D model 'SheenChair.glb' using GLTFLoader. Scale it to (0.5, 0.5, 0.5) and use it as the skier object. Position it at (0, 0.5, 0) initially on the slope.
- The skier moves downhill automatically at a base speed of 0.3 units/frame, accelerating by 0.002 per frame up to a max speed of 1.2.
- Left/Right arrow keys steer the skier laterally at 0.15 units/frame. The skier is bounded to X range [-12, 12].
- The camera follows the skier from behind (offset: 0, 5, 10 relative to skier).

## Obstacles & Gates
- Generate obstacles (red boxes, 1x1x1, color 0xff0000) randomly placed on the slope. Generate at least 20 obstacles spaced every ~20 units along the Z axis at random X positions within [-10, 10].
- Generate scoring gates: pairs of green poles (cylinders, radius 0.2, height 3, color 0x00ff00) placed at intervals of ~25 units along Z. Each gate has two poles at X=-3 and X=3 (with some random offset ±2). Passing between the poles scores points.
- Add 5 boost ramps (yellow boxes 2x0.3x2, color 0xffff00) at random positions that temporarily increase speed by 50% for 3 seconds.

## Scoring System
- Start score at 0. Each gate passed through: +100 points. Each boost ramp hit: +25 points.
- Hitting an obstacle: -50 points and speed reduced by 30% (min speed 0.3).
- Track distance traveled. Every 50 units of distance: +10 points.
- Track combo multiplier: consecutive gates without hitting obstacles increase multiplier (1x, 2x, 3x, max 4x). Hitting an obstacle resets combo to 1x.
- The run ends when the skier travels 500 units total distance.

## Collision Detection
- Use bounding box (AABB) collision detection between skier and all objects.
- Gate passage: skier Z passes gate Z and skier X is between the two poles.
- Obstacle collision: bounding boxes overlap.
- Boost ramp collision: bounding boxes overlap.

## HUD / UI
- Display a DOM overlay HUD with: Score (top-left), Speed (top-right), Combo multiplier (below score), Distance remaining (top-center).
- Add a 'Start Game' button (id='startButton') centered on screen. Game begins only when clicked. Button disappears on click.
- When run ends, show 'Game Over' overlay (id='gameOverOverlay') with final score and a 'Restart' button (id='restartButton').
- Add a pause toggle with 'P' key. Show 'PAUSED' text (id='pauseText') when paused.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
- `gameStarted` (boolean): true after Start is clicked
- `gameOver` (boolean): true when distance >= 500
- `paused` (boolean): true when paused
- `score` (number): current score
- `speed` (number): current speed
- `combo` (number): current combo multiplier (1-4)
- `distance` (number): total distance traveled
- `skierX` (number): skier X position
- `skierZ` (number): skier Z position
- `gatesPassed` (number): count of gates passed
- `obstaclesHit` (number): count of obstacles hit
- `boostsCollected` (number): count of boosts collected
- `boosted` (boolean): whether boost is currently active
- `modelLoaded` (boolean): true when SheenChair.glb is loaded
- `obstacleCount` (number): total obstacles generated
- `gateCount` (number): total gates generated
physics_constraints: Skier accelerates from 0.3 to max 1.2 at 0.002/frame. Lateral movement bounded to [-12,12]. Obstacle collision reduces speed by 30% (min 0.3). Boost increases speed by 50% for 3 seconds. Combo multiplier caps at 4x. Score cannot go below 0. Distance caps at 500.
